CONTEXT: A builder just made changes confined (allegedly) to exactly 2 files, both UNSTAGED:
  overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx
  overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx
There are also 27 other files already STAGED (index vs HEAD) from earlier work, which the builder must NOT have touched. `git status --porcelain` shows `AM` for the two changed files and `A `/`M ` for the rest.

YOUR JOB — angle (d): REGRESSION / COLLATERAL. Falsify the claim that nothing outside the plan changed.

1. **Prove the change set is exactly 2 files.** Run `git status --porcelain` and `git diff --stat` (worktree-vs-index) and `git diff --cached --stat` (index-vs-HEAD). Confirm the worktree-vs-index diff touches ONLY those 2 paths. Also check for UNTRACKED files that shouldn't be there: `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` and `git clean -nd` (dry run only — `-n` is read-only, never run `git clean` without `-n`). Look for stray scratch files, `.orig`/`.rej`/`.bak` files, editor backups, or new files anywhere under the repo. Note: files under `/tmp` or `~/.claude/` are out of scope.

2. **Prove the 27 staged files are untouched by this change.** The `git diff` (worktree vs index) is the authoritative answer, but ALSO verify no staged file's index entry was re-staged during this step: `git diff --cached --stat` and check `.git` index mtime is not evidence of a re-add. Enumerate the 27 staged paths and confirm each has an empty worktree-vs-index diff.

3. **Tier 1 / protected path check.** Read `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md` and `.claude/rules/protectedFiles.md`. Confirm NO Tier 1 path was modified. Specifically confirm untouched: `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `vitest.config.*`, `vitest.setup.ts`, `playwright.config.*`, `.storybook/**`, `lighthouserc.js`, `tests/lighthouserc.js`, `.browserstack.yml`, `babel.config.js`, `tsconfig.json`, `config/**`, `overrides/app/ssr.js`, `overrides/app/ssr/**`, `worker/main.js`, `mobify.config.js`, `overrides/app/theme/foundation/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CODEOWNERS`, `.claude/rules/**`, `.claude/settings.json`, `coderabbit.yaml`, `.coderabbit/**`, `semgrep.yml`, `scripts/hooks/**`, `scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`. Report the tier of the 2 changed files themselves (product-view is listed in protectedFiles.md; product-detail — check whether it appears in any tier list at all).

4. **`.claude/registry/` state.** Read `scripts/hooks/pre-commit` (around lines 49-62) and `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs` (around :25-26). Determine: does `.claude/registry/` currently reflect the working tree or is it stale? Is it dirty in git right now? Was it modified by this step? Report the current state of `.claude/registry/components.md` regarding `ProductView` / `product-view` / `product-detail` entries (grep for them, print the lines) — the plan expects the pre-commit hook to rewrite these at commit time, so the question is only whether the builder pre-emptively touched them (it should NOT have).

5. **`console.*` check.** grep both changed files (working-tree versions) for `console.` — any `console.log`/`console.error`/`console.warn`/`console.debug`. Per AGENTS.md's copy-first rule, temporary `console.log` markers must be REMOVED before the functional commit; per `.claude/rules/conventions.md`, no `console.*` outside error boundaries/dev tooling. Report every hit with file:line. Also check whether the BASE files (`node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-view/index.jsx` and `.../app/pages/product-detail/index.jsx`) contain any `console.*` — if base has one and ours dropped it, that's a fidelity deviation; if ours has one base doesn't, that's a leftover marker.

6. **Internal node_modules import paths.** Per `.claude/rules/conventions.md`: "No imports from internal `node_modules/@salesforce/...` source paths — use the package's published entrypoints." grep both changed files for any import specifier containing `node_modules`, and separately list EVERY import specifier in both files (`grep -n "^import\|from '"`). Flag anything that looks like a deep/internal path rather than a published `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/...` entrypoint. Also flag any relative `../../..` chain longer than 3 levels.

7. **Consumer prop-surface check.** Run:
   `grep -rn "from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-view'" node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/`
   That shows the base importers of ProductView. For EACH importer, read the JSX where it renders `<ProductView ... />` and enumerate every prop it passes. Then read the post-Step-1 `ProductViewProps` type in `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` and confirm EVERY prop those callers pass is present in the type (and that the type has no `required` prop a caller omits). The builder added `promotionId?: string` and `alignItems?: string` for exactly this reason — verify that closes the gap COMPLETELY and that no OTHER caller-passed prop is still missing. Note `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx:473,477` is claimed to pass both. Also check `ref` usage and any named exports the base importers rely on. Report any prop a base caller passes that the type does not declare as a BLOCKER (it would be a tsc error only if the caller were TypeScript — these callers are .jsx so tsc will NOT catch it, which is exactly why this needs manual checking).

OUTPUT: findings-first, ordered by severity: BLOCKER / DEFECT / NOTE. Every finding needs `absolute/file/path:line` and a label **CONFIRMED** / **PLAUSIBLE**. Then a short "What I could not verify" section. Do NOT run `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx vitest`, `npm run lint`, or `npm run audit:tokens` — already run. Do not write any report file into the repo — return findings as your final message text.

## FINDINGS

---

### BLOCKER 1 — The change deletes the entire SFCC-89 feature wiring, orphaning 23 of the 27 staged files. **CONFIRMED**

This is not a 2-file prop-type tidy-up. The worktree-vs-index diff **removes the whole integration** of the staged SFCC-89 work from the app:

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx`
- **-78 lines / +3.** Removed: imports of `ZimmProductContent`, `ZimmProductModelInfo`, `ZimmProductStyleCode`, `selectPdpProductInfo`, `Breadcrumb`, `PromoCallout`, `ProductViewHeaderProps` (staged blob lines 59-71); the entire `renderStaticProductHeader` function and the `staticInfo` computation (staged lines 681-745); `renderHeader={renderStaticProductHeader}` on the `<ProductView>` call (staged line 864, now `:795-811`); and the `<Stack>` holding `<ZimmProductModelInfo>` + `<ZimmProductStyleCode>` (staged lines 879-884, after `<InformationAccordion>` at `:812`).

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx`
- `:144-155` — `renderHeader?: (props: ProductViewHeaderProps) => React.ReactNode` and its 10-line JSDoc deleted from `ProductViewProps`.
- `:253` — `renderHeader` default removed from the destructuring.
- `:661-668` and `:715-722` — both breakpoint header call sites reverted from `renderHeader({...})` to a direct `<ProductViewHeader .../>`.

**Verified collateral — every new component now has zero live consumers.** Exhaustive grep over `overrides/`:

| Symbol | Non-test/story/recipe consumers |
|---|---|
| `ZimmProductContent` | **0** (only its own story + `zimmProductContent.css.ts` + `theme/components/index.ts:31`) |
| `ZimmProductModelInfo` | **0** |
| `ZimmProductStyleCode` | **0** |
| `ZimmProductName` / `ZimmProductPrice` / `ZimmProductDescription` | only `zimmProductContent/index.tsx:33-35` — which itself is unreachable |
| `selectPdpProductInfo` (`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts:48`) | **0** — referenced only by `productInfo.test.ts` |

Nothing in the app renders any of it. The tests and stories still pass (they import the components directly), so **no gate catches this** — `tsc`, `vitest`, `lint`, and `audit:tokens` are all green on dead code. Neither `promotionId` nor `alignItems` required deleting `renderHeader`; the two changes are orthogonal.

*Attribution caveat:* that the deletion was **out of plan** is **PLAUSIBLE**, not confirmed — I was given the change set, not the plan text. The code state is CONFIRMED.

---

### DEFECT 2 — Tier 2 ownership marker deleted from a Tier 2 file. **CONFIRMED**

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:15-19` — the diff removes:

```
 * Tier 2 (Shared Product Components, owner Squad B — see .claude/rules/protectedFiles.md).
```

`overrides/app/components/product-view/` **is** Tier 2 per `.claude/rules/protectedFiles.md` (Shared Product Components, Owner: Squad B — notify Squad A). Removing the in-file tier signal is gratuitous to the stated goal and leaves the next reader with no local cue. Non-author PR review still required.

---

### DEFECT 3 — Now-dead public type export. **CONFIRMED**

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:101` — `export type ProductViewHeaderProps` retains its `export` keyword, but its only external consumer (the removed `product-detail` import) is gone. Still used internally at `:178`, so harmless at runtime; it is residue of the reverted design.

---

### NOTE 4 — Step 7 prop-surface check: the gap **is** closed; three unmapped props are faithful base parity, not blockers. **CONFIRMED**

Base importers of `ProductView` (`grep` over `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/`): `product-view-modal/index.jsx:17`, `product-view-modal/bundle.jsx:21`, `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx:22`, `pages/product-detail/index.jsx:41` (shadowed by our override), plus `product-view/index.test.js:18`.

Every prop passed at those 6 JSX sites is declared in `ProductViewProps` **except** three:

- `isLoading` — `product-view-modal/index.jsx:46`, `bundle.jsx:112` & `:151`, `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx:469`
- `showReviews`, `showVariationAttributes` — `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx:475-476`
- (plus `{...props}` spread carrying `isOpen`/`onOpen`/`onClose`/`onReturnToSelection` per those modals' own `propTypes`)

**These are not blockers.** Base `ProductView.propTypes` (`node_modules/.../product-view/index.jsx:1015-1052`) does not declare them either, and base never destructures or consumes them — `grep` confirms base's only `isLoading` uses are `:433`/`:456`, passing `isBasketLoading`/`isWishlistLoading` *down to* `Button`s (mirrored exactly at override `:523`/`:546`). Passing them is inert in base and inert in the override. No behavioural divergence.

**`promotionId` and `alignItems` close the gap correctly and faithfully.** Base declares both in `propTypes` (`:1046`, `:1049`) and destructures **neither** — and the override does exactly the same: declared at `overrides/.../product-view/index.tsx:147` and `:151`, absent from the destructuring at `:216-256`. Correct.

**Ref and export parity intact.** Base exports only a default (`index.jsx:1054`); the override's extra exports (`:93`, `:101`, `:168`) are type-only and erase at compile. `ProductViewHeader` is private in both. The `typeof ref === 'function'` `this`-rebinding contract that `bundle.jsx:139-145` and base `product-detail/index.jsx:709-716` depend on is preserved (`:160`, `:168`).

---

### NOTE 5 — Change set boundary is clean. **CONFIRMED**

- `git diff --name-only` = exactly the 2 claimed paths. `git diff-files --name-status` agrees (`M`/`M`).
- All 27 other staged paths verified individually: **empty worktree-vs-index diff** for each.

- Artefact sweep (`.orig`, `.rej`, `.bak`, `.swp`, `*~`, `.tmp`, `.patch`, `.diff`, `scratch*`, `.log`, excluding `node_modules`/`.git`/`build`/`storybook-static`): **zero hits**.
- No re-staging: `.git/index` mtime `2026-08-26 01:16:39` **precedes** both changed-file mtimes (`01:37:58`, `01:41:03`). Index blobs `7eb15dc`/`e4ea386` still match the pre-edit content. No merge/rebase in progress (only `ORIG_HEAD` present).

### NOTE 6 — Tier 1 sweep: all clean. **CONFIRMED**

Zero worktree **and** zero index diff for every path in the brief: `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `vitest.config.ts`, `vitest.setup.ts`, `playwright.config.js`, `lighthouserc.js`, `.browserstack.yml`, `babel.config.js`, `tsconfig.json`, `worker/main.js`, `overrides/app/ssr.js`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CODEOWNERS`, `.claude/settings.json`, `coderabbit.yaml`, `semgrep.yml`, `scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`, and directories `config/`, `overrides/app/ssr/`, `.storybook/`, `.github/workflows/`, `.claude/rules/`, `.coderabbit/`, `scripts/hooks/`, `overrides/app/theme/foundation/`. (`mobify.config.js`, `tests/lighthouserc.js`, `vitest.config.js`, `playwright.config.ts` do not exist in this repo.)

Tier of the 2 changed files: **`product-view/` is Tier 2** (protectedFiles.md, Shared Product Components / Squad B). **`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/` appears in no tier list** — it is Tier 4 by omission, though `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` ("Known gaps") flags it as claimed by draft `.claude/rules/squadA.md`.

*Adjacent, pre-existing (staged, not this change):* `overrides/app/routes.tsx` and `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` are both **Tier 2** (Global Shell; Theme Component Styles / UI Designer).

### NOTE 7 — `.claude/registry/` stale but correctly untouched. **CONFIRMED**

`scripts/hooks/pre-commit:49-63` regenerates and `git add`s the registry when anything under `overrides/app/{components,hooks,utils,pages}` or `routes.tsx` is staged — so it will rewrite at commit time, as the plan expects.

Current state: **git-clean** (`git diff`/`git diff --cached` on `.claude/registry/` both empty; not gitignored except `.baseCache.json`). mtimes `2026-08-24 17:21:08` — predating both edits. **Not touched by this step.**

It **is stale** relative to the working tree:
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.claude/registry/components.md:54` — `| ProductView | Base | app/components/product-view/index.jsx | ... |` — still says **Base**, though the override is staged.
- `.claude/registry/components.md` — **zero** `zimmProduct*` rows (all 6 new components missing).
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.claude/registry/pages.md:20` — `| ProductDetail | Base | app/pages/product-detail/index.jsx |` — still **Base**.

Correct behaviour; flagged only so the staleness isn't mistaken for a signal.

### NOTE 8 — `console.*`: clean on all four surfaces. **CONFIRMED**

Zero hits in the worktree version of both changed files, zero in their index versions, and **zero in both base files** (`node_modules/.../components/product-view/index.jsx`, `.../pages/product-detail/index.jsx`). No leftover copy-first marker, no dropped base call. No fidelity deviation either direction.

### NOTE 9 — Imports: clean. **CONFIRMED**

No import specifier contains `node_modules` — the three matches (`product-view/index.tsx:10`, `product-detail/index.tsx:10` and `:56`) are prose inside comments. No relative chain exceeds 3 levels. The only relative imports are `product-detail/index.tsx:58-59` → `'../../components/product-view'` (2 levels), which is **required** by `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` ("Importing an already-overridden component from a new component") so Storybook/Vitest resolve the override rather than silently testing base. Everything else uses published `@salesforce/...` entrypoints. `image-gallery`, `display-price`, `swatch-group` confirmed still un-overridden, so their base-path imports are correct.

Dead imports correctly pruned: `VStack`, `Skeleton`, `formatNumber`, `Breadcrumb`, `PromoCallout` all have 0 remaining references in `product-detail/index.tsx`; `Stack` was correctly **retained** (still used at `:697`, `:818`).

### NOTE 10 — The three new `audit-allow:` comments are legitimate. **CONFIRMED**

All three claims byte-verified against base, and all three are mechanically effective (`scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs:118-120` walks back only to the previous blank line; each marker sits inside the offending line's paragraph):

Authored/committed `Marcel Angelo Navarro <marcel.a.n.navarro@accenture.com>`, `2026-08-26 00:29:14 +0800` — **before** the `.git/index` write (01:16) and the two file edits (01:37/01:41). Not pushed to any remote. Given the timestamp and authorship this most likely predates the audited change, so I am **not** asserting a Hard Rule #15 violation — but a commit and branch were created outside the "2 unstaged files" claim, which the brief did not mention.

*Also unmentioned:* a separate pushed SFCC-89 branch exists — `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-ui-static-product-information` @ `d526ad1` (with `review/SFCC-89` at the same commit). Possible duplicate-work risk; out of scope here.

### NOTE 12 — Orphaned theme recipes ship CSS for nothing. **CONFIRMED**

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts:13-16,31-34` (staged) registers `ZimmProductContent`, `ZimmProductDescription`, `ZimmProductPrice`, `ZimmProductStyleCode`. ## What I could not verify

- **Whether the deletion was in-plan.** I was given the change set, not the plan text or the builder's brief. The brief's framing ("added `promotionId`/`alignItems` for exactly this reason") describes only the type additions and never mentions removing `renderHeader` or the page wiring — which is what drives my PLAUSIBLE label on intent. I reasoned about `audit:tokens` by reading `scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` rather than executing it; the three `audit-allow` placements should be recognised, but that is a static read of the regex and context-window logic, not an observed pass.

- **Whether commit `3ae8dcd` was created by the builder in this session** vs. by the user earlier. Timestamps and authorship suggest the latter; the reflog cannot distinguish agent-initiated from human-initiated commits.
